data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for selecting images/videos from the gallery and capturing new ones via camera.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to pick single or multiple images, videos, or mixed media from the device's library or take new photos and videos using the camera. It returns cross-platform XFile objects representing the selected media.
use_when: You need users to select existing photos or videos from their device gallery.
Your app requires taking new pictures or recording videos using the device camera.
You need cross-platform support for picking media across mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You need full in-app custom camera viewfinders and advanced hardware controls instead of a simple photo-capture intent.
You require complex image editing, filtering, or heavy image manipulation out of the box.
strengths: Supports multiple platform implementations (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Handles lost data recovery on Android when low-memory kills the application.
Uses modern native pickers such as PHPicker on iOS and Android Photo Picker on newer versions.
weaknesses: Desktop platforms have limited support and require a third-party camera delegate for capturing photos.
Android low-memory process death requires manual implementation of retrieveLostData checks.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS Info.plist permission descriptions for photo library, camera, and microphone. macOS requires user-selected files read-only entitlement. Android requires no configuration out of the box.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to decode, manipulate, and convert image formats directly in Dart code.

alternatives.name: extended_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need advanced image loading, zooming, panning, and cropping widgets.

data.minimal_example:
final picker = ImagePicker();
final XFile? image = await picker.pickImage(source: ImageSource.gallery);
